edeq.com.co: 62. The gap: link names.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But links must have discernible text.

Lesson: Give every link text that says where it goes. An icon alone needs an aria-label.

eep.com.co: 33. The gap: HSTS.

12 pages are kept out of search on purpose, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But HSTS is not sent.

Lesson: Send Strict-Transport-Security with a max-age of at least a year, so browsers never try plain http again.

Lesson: Keep body text at a 4.5:1 contrast ratio or more against its background.

epa.gov.co: 74. The gap: AI crawler access.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and model-training crawlers are blocked by choice. But 1 AI answer or search crawler is blocked.

Lesson: Decide per bot in robots.txt: allow the answer engines you want to be cited by, and block only training crawlers.

Scored 55 of 100. The gap: form labels.

Every internal link that was opened answered, and model-training crawlers are blocked by choice. But 38 form controls have no label.

Lesson: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.
